description: This file provides a shell script-based wrapper for managing system services using start-stop-daemon. It defines functions to start, stop, check, reload, and send signals to services, with configurable environment variables for customization.

methods.name: service
methods.description: Main function to manage service actions (start, stop, check, etc.) with dynamic argument handling based on provided flags.

methods.name: service_check
methods.description: Checks if a service's process is alive using the -C action of start-stop-daemon.

methods.name: service_signal
methods.description: Sends a signal to a service, defaulting to USR1, using start-stop-daemon with -K.

methods.name: service_start
methods.description: Starts a service using start-stop-daemon with the -S action.

methods.name: service_stop
methods.description: Stops a service gracefully, attempting multiple checks and then killing if necessary, using start-stop-daemon with -K.

methods.name: service_reload
methods.description: Reloads a service by sending a reload signal, defaulting to HUP.
